# EVEngine SDK

> C++20 Vulkan game engine. Games are EveScript (`.nut`, Squirrel-compatible). Agents must not invent Unity/Godot APIs.

## Entry rules (read first)

1. Module user docs start with **这篇解决什么**: problems covered, preferred entry API, and what not to do. Read that block before the rest of the page.
2. Search by the problem, then call the documented entry. Prefer `eve_api_search` / `eve_api_get` for signatures from this build.
3. Do not rebuild a documented higher-level path from lower-level primitives (e.g. do not scan every enemy unit when a query API exists).
4. When cost looks wrong, profile at scale (`eve.Profiler.hotspots` / MCP `eve_profiler_hotspots`); a tiny scene is not evidence.

## For coding agents

- [share/eve/ai/SKILL.md](share/eve/ai/SKILL.md): short EveScript + conventions + concept map
- [share/eve/ai/eve-api.json](share/eve/ai/eve-api.json): this SDK build's Binding Contracts (`eve.binding-api`)
- [share/eve/ai/eve-api.d.ts](share/eve/ai/eve-api.d.ts): TypeScript-shaped signatures (not a second runtime)
- [share/eve/ai/asset-kits/](share/eve/ai/asset-kits/): AI asset kits (card / visual-novel pixel sizes); MCP `eve_asset_kit_list` / `eve_asset_kit_get`
- [share/eve/examples/basic/main.nut](share/eve/examples/basic/main.nut): gold example
- [share/eve/styles/stylized-grass/README.md](share/eve/styles/stylized-grass/README.md): CPU-generated default grass with no external art or shader assets

## For runtime agents

- `bin/eve run --debug --mcp-port=7529 share/eve/examples/basic`
- MCP stdio bridge: `share/eve/ai/eve-mcp/` (see its README)
- Tools: `eve_api_search` / `eve_api_get` (lookup), `eve_asset_kit_list` / `eve_asset_kit_get` (art sizes), `eve_play` (observe/act), `eve_screenshot` (engine PNG), `eve_profiler_frame` / `eve_profiler_report` (hotspots)
- Do not use `eve_eval` as the official gameplay path
